description: NetBird community-edition dashboard v3. Covers NetBird app metrics, Traefik router/entrypoint metrics, and EC2 host metrics (via Alloy's built-in unix exporter). Replaces v2's broken Update-channel panels (metric removed in 0.71.x) with store-transaction latency.

panels.description: Active peer streams currently connected to the management gRPC server.

panels.description: Peers currently exchanging traffic through the relay.
panels.title: Relay peers (active)

panels.description: Idle relay peer slots — connected to the relay but no traffic flowing.
panels.title: Relay peers (idle)

panels.description: Open management proxy connections.
panels.title: Proxy connections

panels.description: Management server uptime since last process start.
panels.title: Uptime

HTTP error rate (5xx + auth fails)
panels.description: Rate of HTTP 5xx + 401/403 responses from the management API.

panels.title: Slowest endpoints (p99 last 5m)
panels.description: Per-endpoint p99 latency over the last 5 minutes. Sort by Latency desc to find offenders.

panels.title: Account-update notifications by resource × operation
panels.description: Which kinds of config changes are notifying peers. Useful for spotting test workloads that cause excessive peer churn.

panels.title: Proxy connections over time
panels.description: Active connections through the OSS reverse proxy.

panels.title: Proxy heartbeats per second
panels.description: Rate of heartbeats received from configured proxy peers.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Unbounded growth indicates a leak.

panels.title: GC pause (p99)
panels.description: P99 of stop-the-world GC pause duration.

panels.title: Heap in use
panels.description: Bytes currently allocated on the Go heap.

panels.title: Store transaction latency (p50/p90/p99)
panels.description: Time to execute a single store/DB transaction. With SQLite, watch p99 for IO contention as the lab grows.

panels.title: Store transaction rate
panels.description: Transactions/sec against the store. Sudden spikes correlate with bulk config changes or peer-storm conditions.

panels.title: PAT usage distribution
panels.description: Counts of Personal Access Token uses. The histogram's `_count` total rises with API calls authenticated via PATs.

panels.title: Request rate by router
panels.description: HTTP requests/sec at Traefik, grouped by router (gRPC vs API vs OAuth2 vs dashboard).

panels.title: Router p99 latency
panels.description: P99 latency observed at the Traefik router layer (includes time in the backend service).

panels.title: Router 4xx/5xx rate
panels.description: HTTP error rate per router. Distinguishes app errors from auth challenges depending on which router serves them.

panels.title: Open connections by entrypoint
panels.description: Current open connections at each Traefik entrypoint (web/websecure/metrics).

panels.title: CPU usage %
panels.description: Percent of CPU time NOT idle, averaged across cores. 50% on a 2-vCPU box ≈ one core fully busy.

panels.title: Memory used %
panels.description: (MemTotal - MemAvailable) / MemTotal. MemAvailable accounts for reclaimable cache.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: 1m / 5m / 15m load. Stays well below NumCPU when healthy (here, 2).

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Host-level NIC bytes/s, excluding loopback. Receive negative, transmit positive.
